title: Merging Distinct Bounded Context Domains
pattern: Coalescing semantic terms from different bounded contexts into a single "universal" or "god" struct.
why_bad: It destroys linguistic and boundary context, causing "conceptual splinters." Code becomes tightly coupled, changes to e-commerce logic risk breaking shipping logic, and optional fields multiply because most fields are irrelevant to any single context.
detection: Large structs containing fields that are clearly scoped to distinct business domains (e.g. shipping logistics vs. retail billing) under a single team.
